spec_match.rationale: Real files in-repo, real byte counts, real createImageBitmap decode timings per format, and an undecodable format reported as a named failure — matching the feature's decode-only scope.

interactive.rationale: A runs-to-average slider and a Run button produce a measured table, byte bars, and a live four-format gallery with per-image load/error captions.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises real byte counts and decode timings measured in your browser with no blog-post claims, and the note honestly caveats cross-format quality comparability.

edge_cases.rationale: The undecodable-format branch is first-class (verified: JXL row shows 'no — InvalidStateError' and its caption says the browser could not decode it) and the quality-setting caveat prevents the numbers being oversold.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite is behavioural and matches this page's method, but it carries the syntactically broken picture-negotiation assertion (flagged in the decode-probe critique) that fails on every browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp) via CDP: Run measured JXL 29.5KB (27% smaller, no decode — InvalidStateError), AVIF 16.9KB/6.49ms, WebP 21.1KB/5.44ms, JPEG 40.1KB baseline/3.96ms; gallery captions matched; only failed request was the expected aborted .jxl; screenshots both viewports.

telemetry_health.rationale: Runs log per-format results and emit showcaseTelemetry.assert('formats-compared', …) with decodable count and JXL status.

design_system.rationale: Token colours, disabled Run state, byte bars use bordered token fills with text labels, ok/bad cells pair colour with words.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned measurement table with scoped headers, gallery images with descriptive alt and status figcaptions, labelled slider, aria-live result output.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 over CDP; gallery and bars reflow cleanly on mobile in the screenshot.

openQuestions.title: Consider a progressive-decode angle using the shipped fixture
openQuestions.detail: The repo already contains image-progressive.jxl but no page uses it, and progressive decoding is one of the format's headline capabilities named on the feature index. Once a decoding browser is available, a concept that streams the progressive file (fetch with a throttled reader into a blob/img refresh) and shows early-pass rendering would cover the capability the current portfolio only mentions.

summary: Honest measured comparison, verified over CDP on Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp) at http://localhost:3000/v155/jpeg-xl-decoding-support-image-jxl-in-blink/format-showdown/: the JXL row fails diagnosably while AVIF/WebP/JPEG decode with real timings, the narration states this is the pre-155 state, gallery captions agree, console clean, no overflow on either class. Feature /conformance/ route ran 3 pass / 4 fail — three honest missing-decoder failures plus the broken picture-negotiation assertion flagged separately. The unused image-progressive.jxl fixture is the obvious next angle.
